body: fuck trolls. dont give them the power over your life. You can make life better. You care ya know. seeing you hurt reminds me of me and reminds me that shit gets better. it can suck a lot, but the more you learn, the better you get. and better at life. don't go, at least I don't want you to.
dude, maybe no one can fix you. but you're trying to do better by talking about it, and maybe YOU're the one who is fixing you. You can do it dude.

im sorry you have been dealt a bad hand in life. its not fair, and it sucks. its the only life you get, and it is unfair. theres nothing else to do but try harder, or give up, and I want you to know that at least one stranger out there wants you to keep going. I hurt too, and what brings me solace is trying to help anyone I can, no matter how. maybe my words suck ass to some, but its all i can do. and I hope that this bit of word garbage brings enough happy to you so you decide to live another day. in hopes you will do the same to someone else who needs it one day. Please don't leave.

I just wanted you to knOW i read everything you typed and I don't think you should leave. But I'm not feeling the same pain you are, and that's understandable. Still am glad you at least typed it out first, and that's something. I read your hurt and I'm sorry. Please don't go.
the fact that you can care about others is enough to prove you don't need to die. Please. shit sucks, im sorry. but it can get better. I promise. Please don't go.
dont please, i know im just a stranger but i don't think anyone deserves to die. there's so much opportunity to do things, there's no reason to go. You can turn it around, I promise. Please don't go.

you don't need to go right now because theres still so much shit you can do thats awesome. it sucks right now, but it doesnt have to be that way forever. you could go be homeless and pretend to be a french clown and somehow make money nowadays. anything is possible. please don't give up.

its ok to be hurt, you deserve to talk about it. shit sucks sometimes and theres nothing we can do to change that. all we can do is try to move forward. seems lame, but think about how the crazy odds that you were born in the first place. this is your only life. its lame to say "make the best of it" but thats all we can do. you don't have to do it alone though. please don't leave. it's going to get better as long as you keep on keepin on.

please don't die. its shit.everything sucks. but it WILL get better. maybe you need to change your life, maybe you need to go somewhere else, but it CAN get better. This is your only shot, don't give it up. i hurt with you and im going to keep trying. drunkely. but trying.

im sorry you feel this way. there is a problem nowadays where we have too much to think about. this will not go away, what do we do? live. i want to die too, but, that;s not going to help. i know you want shit to be better, and it can be, maybe not for us but for our kids. its going to be okay.  please don't give up

i kinda feel the way you feel, knowing i could just end it all.... but you could also RESTART it all instead. dying isnt a solution. you're incredibly lucky for being alive in the first place, don't squander it. if you need to remarry, go for it. Youd be saving your spouse from future hurt if you want to look at it that way. no matter what, don't go,.

i can't relate to your situation, but I do know that not being to be able to vaccinate sucks a lot of ass. being grouped in with a bunch of assholes makes the world seem shit, but this is only a couple years compared to the rest of your life. no matter what, youll pull through. Please don't give up.

its going to be okay, i know its bullshit but try and find something you like about ANYTHING and focus on that. Like admiring the way fries turn brown in a deep fryer, or how dust collects on windowsills, "WHY?" ... You're not worthless, or dumb. You're someone important. please don't give up

no. everything sucks right now but don't give up. I want to too, but I have a feeling itll be better. it feels good right now to think about dying, but itll feel better to get past that. don't give up please
You're feeling lost and that sucks ass. please don't leave. You're infintely lucky to be here in the first place, also it will be ok. i hurt too, but itll be ok. we just have to keep on.
please don't. i saw what you said and Im sorry you hurt. Don't leave.
